meta.name: self-improver
meta.description: Review affiliate campaign results and improve strategy. Triggers on: "review my results", "what went wrong", "how to improve conversions", "analyze my campaign", "affiliate retrospective", "why am I not converting", "improve my strategy", "what should I change", "campaign review", "optimize my approach", "learn from my results", "post-mortem on my campaign".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查并改进联盟营销活动策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是联盟营销人员，想通过数据分析提升转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Review and improve affiliate campaign strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an affiliate marketer looking to boost conversions through data analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，当你请求分析联盟营销活动时，Claude会回顾活动结果，诊断哪些有效、哪些无效，并生成一个优先改进计划。它使用联盟营销特定的诊断框架来找出根本原因和可操作修复方法。
howto.when: 当你提到“review my results”、“what went wrong”、“how to improve conversions”等关键词，或要求分析你的联盟营销活动时触发。

say.text: 回顾我最近的联盟营销活动结果
say.note: Claude会回顾你的活动数据并生成评估

say.text: 为什么我的转化率这么低？
say.note: Claude会诊断转化率低的原因

say.text: 帮我优化我的联盟营销策略
say.note: Claude会提出改进方案并排序

howto.what_en: When you ask to review affiliate campaign results, Claude uses diagnostic frameworks to analyze performance, identify root causes of gaps, and generate a prioritized improvement plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use keywords like "review my results", "what went wrong", "how to improve conversions", or when you request campaign analysis.

say_en.text: Review my recent affiliate campaign results.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates your data and generates an assessment.

say_en.text: Why are my conversions so low?
Help me optimize my affiliate strategy.
